name: jev-sim-use
description: Teaches agents to reach simulator screens with one jev-sim-use command instead of driving sim-use tap by tap.

interface.shortDescription: Reach simulator screens with one command.
interface.longDescription: jev-sim-use lets Codex delegate simulator navigation to Jev, one command per goal, and keep sim-use for precise checks.
defaultPrompt: Open Settings > Display in the simulator with jev-sim-use.
Get the app to the search results for ramen, then check the first result.
